Per-commit measurement (git log --format='%h %an <%ae>' origin/main..HEAD): of the 20
commits on this branch, exactly TWO are offenders -- 727751f and 24333c2. BOTH are
review-record commits. ALL NINE CONTENT COMMITS ARE CLEAN LEAPWare. So the package

For my own commit I set the identity explicitly and verified lwb_check_commit_identity
passes for my commit alone before pushing. THIS IS A STANDING DEFECT IN THE REVIEWER
ROUTINE, not in this PR, and it is the single most valuable thing in this record: every
further review cycle on any branch is a coin flip on killing that branch.
